question: After every admitted, closed or quarantined issue #421 family is applied, does exact current-main retain any gameplay-consumed combat state or card-zone representation that can express the missing second Duskblade complementarity package?

hypotheses.H0: Every exact combat, combatant and card-instance field is already an admitted package, a closed or quarantined grammar alias, a decomposed container or fixed product context.
hypotheses.H1: Exactly one field surface has an existing gameplay consumer and no immutable issue #421 disposition.

competingOptions: freeze at most one exact unclosed state surface for a separate capacity preregistration
close existing combat state and card-zone grammar, establishing the issue-body precondition for a separately preregistered smallest new deterministic mediator
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap
scientificBasis: Exact source owns a finite 52-field state vocabulary across CombatState, PlayerCombatant, EnemyCombatant and CardInst. A one-to-one field audit is cheaper and stricter than proposing another card: it can prove whether any existing state or zone consumer remains after immutable decisions, without outcome support, simulator rows or a chosen payoff.

stateSurfaceCoverage.aliasStructure: Encounter identity, stable object identity, authored AI flags and terminal handoff select or describe the running product. Elite/fight-quality triggers are closed; changing an encounter, act, identity or flag subset would be content selection, not an unconsumed strategy mediator.
These two fields contain the separately enumerated PlayerCombatant and EnemyCombatant fields and add no state of their own.

Turn setup/action order and retained Energy are closed; Lantern Art and Kindle counters are closed; existing play/Attack cadence consumers reduce to closed damage, strength or Ward payoffs. Queue transport was exhaustively partitioned and its sole unused-transition audit is quarantined, so no event rescue or new cadence payoff is available.

Hand size is admitted for Ashwarden; draw/cycle and Skill-chip sequencing are closed; discard/exhaust terminal movement is universal or Kindle/Ember context; reshuffle is quarantined; same-instance growth is closed; upgrade observation failed identity and cannot be rescued.

Every exact Ember consumer and current Facet ownership, chip, Shatter, Prism and Skill-chip route has an immutable closure or quarantine. A different consumer or payoff would be a new primitive, not unused existing grammar.

Bloodfire/hand-size support is admitted for Ashwarden. HP-loss quality, recovery, Ward, Energy, power/status setup and turn reservoirs are closed or fixed combat resources. Recombining their thresholds or payoffs would reopen a closed family.

Enemy HP/terminal topology, Ward, statuses, intent history, stagger and Facet state map to exact closed or quarantined families. Selecting a threshold, enemy, intent, status subset or observation repair is forbidden.

factorDisposition.candidate: No card, relic, effect, carrier, payoff or acquisition path is selected.
factorDisposition.method: No ML, RL, optimiser, fitted model or adaptive search is used.
factorDisposition.support: No trace, cache, policy support or outcome endpoint is read.

decisionRules.success: All 52 fields are covered exactly once and exactly one preregistered state surface is marked uncovered, with every source, evidence and ledger identity exact within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the one preregistered unclosed surface for a separate zero-row capacity protocol. Do not choose a payoff, carrier, factor, method or row.
decisionRules.futility: All 52 fields are covered exactly once and no state surface is uncovered.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the existing combat-state and card-zone grammar. This establishes that exact current grammar cannot supply the missing Duskblade complementarity package. Continue under the issue-body authority only with a separately preregistered smallest new deterministic mediator design; do not retry any mapped field, observation or payoff.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The source field set, one-to-one coverage, evidence identity, ledger identity or 30-second cap fails.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the audit inconclusive without selecting a state surface, candidate, method, support row or protected seed.
